instruction: This paper looks very interesting. Please locate the personal webpages for the fourth and fifth authors listed in the paper. Save them in a bookmark folder called 'Paper Contributors' in the 'Bookmarks bar'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('f11'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.scroll(-20)

metadata.explanation: Task requires: 1) Opening PDF and identifying 4th author (Yuncong Yang) and 5th author (Haoyi Zhu), 2) Searching for their personal webpages (LinkedIn profiles are publicly available for these authors), 3) Creating bookmark folder 'Paper Contributors', 4) Bookmarking the found URLs. Uses existing is_expected_bookmarks metric. Verified author names from PDF page 1.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if correct URLs are bookmarked in correct folder, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirements: checks for folder named 'Paper Contributors' in bookmark bar with the two specified LinkedIn URLs
Metric function properly uses rule.get('names', []) to extract folder name 'Paper Contributors' from configuration
URL verification logic correctly checks if both LinkedIn profiles (Yuncong Yang and Haoyi Zhu) are bookmarked in the folder
Complete coverage: verifies both the folder name and the presence of correct URLs
Data flow is correct: get_bookmarks getter extracts Chrome bookmarks → metric receives bookmarks dict → checks for folder with specified name → verifies URLs match expected values
